info.description: HotPlex Worker Gateway — unified access layer for AI Coding Agent sessions.
info.title: HotPlex API

get.description: Returns all API key user records. API keys are masked in the response. Requires admin:read scope.

post.description: Creates a new API key user. If api_key is omitted, one is auto-generated. Returns the full API key only on creation. Requires admin:write scope.

get.description: Returns a single API key user by ID. API key is masked. Requires admin:read scope.

delete.description: Permanently deletes an API key user and revokes the associated API key. Requires admin:write scope.

patch.description: Updates the user_id and description of an existing API key user. The api_key itself is immutable. Requires admin:write scope.

get.description: Returns skills under the global .agents/.claude/.hotplex dirs with search & pagination. Requires admin:read.

parameters.description: Search query for skill name or description
parameters.name: q

post.description: Upload a skill zip into ~/.agents/skills. Use ?replace=true to overwrite. Requires admin:write.

get.description: Returns detail of a global skill including full SKILL.md body and files list. Requires admin:read.

put.description: Update SKILL.md body of a global managed skill. Requires admin:write.

delete.description: Deletes a global managed skill. Requires admin:write.

get.description: Returns all registered bots and their current connection status. Requires admin:read scope.

post.description: Registers a new bot with the specified platform configuration. Requires admin:write scope.

400.description: Invalid JSON or missing bot name

get.description: Returns full configuration for all registered bots. Requires admin:read scope.
Returns the content of a single platform-level agent config file (channel team default). Used for platforms without a bot instance, e.g. webchat. Requires admin:read scope.
get.summary: Get channel default agent config file

400.description: Invalid platform or config file name

put.description: Writes content to a single platform-level agent config file (channel team default). Used for platforms without a bot instance, e.g. webchat. Requires admin:write scope.
put.summary: Write channel default agent config file

400.description: Invalid platform/config file or write failed

get.description: Returns details for a single registered bot. Requires admin:read scope.

delete.description: Removes a bot registration by name. Returns 409 if the bot is currently running. Requires admin:write scope.

patch.description: Partially updates an existing bot's configuration attributes. Requires admin:write scope.

get.description: Returns the full configuration including agent config summary for a single bot. Requires admin:read scope.
Returns the content of a single agent config file (SOUL.md, AGENTS.md, TOOLS.md, USER.md, MEMORY.md). Requires admin:read scope.

put.description: Writes content to a single agent config file (SOUL.md, AGENTS.md, TOOLS.md, USER.md, MEMORY.md). Requires admin:write scope.

400.description: Invalid config file or write failed

get.description: Returns the fully assembled system prompt for a bot, combining all agent config files. Requires admin:read scope.

post.description: Reverts the live configuration to a specified history version. Requires config:read scope.
Validates a partial configuration object and returns any errors or warnings. Requires config:read scope.

get.description: Returns all configured cron jobs. Requires admin:read scope.

post.description: Creates a new scheduled cron job. Requires admin:write scope.

get.description: Returns details for a single cron job by ID. Requires admin:read scope.

delete.description: Permanently deletes a cron job. Requires admin:write scope.

patch.description: Partially updates an existing cron job. Requires admin:write scope.

post.description: Manually triggers an immediate run of a cron job. Requires admin:write scope.

get.description: Returns the execution history for a cron job. Requires admin:read scope.
Returns session details plus debug snapshot including worker state and turn count. Requires admin:read scope.
Lists external-delivery effects with their lifecycle state. Requires runtime:read scope.
Returns one effect plus every send attempt, so an operator can see what each try actually established. Requires runtime:read scope.

post.description: Abandons, confirms or requeues an unknown delivery effect. Conditional on expected_status; conflicts return 409 so the operator re-inspects instead of double-deciding. Requires runtime:write scope.

200.description: Applied decision and updated effect fact

400.description: Invalid decision, status, reason or evidence_ref

409.description: Effect is no longer unknown: re-inspect before retrying

503.description: Effect store not configured or timed out

get.description: Returns a bounded, newest-first page of execution records for the operator console. Supports keyset pagination and optional session/status/time filters. Requires runtime:read scope.

parameters.description: Only executions created at or after this epoch ms
parameters.name: since_ms

parameters.description: Only executions created before this epoch ms
parameters.name: until_ms

get.description: Lists executions whose runtime ended ambiguous and raised a fence. Requires runtime:read scope.

post.description: Resolves (clears fence, keeps runtime unknown) or abandons (clears fence, fails runtime with OPERATOR_ABANDONED) a fenced execution. Conditional on expected_fence_version; conflicts return 409. Requires runtime:write scope.

200.description: Applied decision and updated execution fact

400.description: Invalid decision, fence version, reason, or evidence_ref

409.description: Fence version conflict: re-inspect before retrying

503.description: Execution store not configured or timed out

post.description: Settles a durable-queue input that has NOT been dispatched yet. Conditional on the item still being queued: once the dispatch boundary is crossed the input may be running or finished, and the call returns 409 instead of a false success. Requires runtime:write scope.

409.description: Input is no longer queued: it has been dispatched

get.description: Returns a bounded, redacted projection of a single execution: its control facts, a capped window of session events, and the external deliveries planned for it. Reports explicitly when plan or effect evidence was never recorded for THIS run, and offers only the actions valid for the record's current state. The notes array carries stable codes (events_unavailable, events_not_configured, events_truncated, effects_unavailable, effects_not_configured, effects_truncated, no_delivery_planned) rather than prose. Requires runtime:read scope.

parameters.description: Only events at or after this epoch ms
parameters.name: since_ms

parameters.description: Only events before this epoch ms
parameters.name: until_ms

get.description: Returns health status for gateway, database, and workers. Requires health:read scope.
Returns health status for each connected worker. Returns 503 if any worker is unhealthy.

503.description: One or more workers are unhealthy

get.description: Returns the most recent log entries from the in-memory ring buffer. Requires admin:read scope.

post.description: Triggers a graceful gateway restart via the restart helper. Requires admin:write scope.

get.description: Lists all sessions, optionally filtered by user_id and platform. Requires session:read scope.

post.description: Creates a new AI agent session. Requires session:write scope.

get.description: Returns total, max, and per-user session pool counts. Requires stats:read scope.
Returns full session details by ID. Requires session:read scope.

delete.description: Permanently deletes a session. Requires session:delete scope.

post.description: Cancels every queued-but-not-dispatched input for a session. Inputs already dispatched (running, finished or fenced) are left alone. Requires runtime:write scope.
post.summary: Clear a session's undispatched input queue

400.description: Invalid session id, reason or evidence_ref

get.description: Returns the redacted desired-state runtime plan and observed bootstrap summary for a session. Requires runtime:read and session:read scopes.

403.description: Insufficient scope: need runtime:read and session:read

get.description: Returns turn count and token usage statistics for a session. Requires session:read scope.

post.description: Sends termination signal to the session worker (SIGTERM then SIGKILL). Requires session:write scope.

get.description: Returns uptime, active sessions, WebSocket connections, and per-worker-type aggregates.
Returns every workspace across owners with owner display identity. Requires admin:read.

patch.description: Change a workspace's permission_mode. Admin-only. Affects new sessions only.

get.description: Returns paginated list of sessions for the caller's user identity. Default platform filter is "webchat"; pass platform=all to include all platforms.

post.description: Creates a new AI agent session. client_session_id is required. workspace_id is optional: omit it for legacy/platform/cron integrations (work_dir falls back to query param or config default); pass it on the WebChat multi-tenant track (caller must own it, 403 WORKSPACE_FORBIDDEN otherwise; work_dir taken from workspace, immutable). Session id is UUIDv5 derived from (userID, workerType, clientKey, workspaceID, workDir) — 方案3.

parameters.description: Workspace ID (optional; required only on WebChat multi-tenant track, caller must own it)
parameters.name: workspace_id

get.description: Returns full session details. Ownership check: caller must own the session.

delete.description: Gracefully terminates the worker and physically deletes the session. Ownership check applies.

post.description: Changes the working directory for an active session. Creates a new derived session ID. Ownership check applies.

get.description: Returns paginated AEP events for a session. Use cursor and direction for navigation. Ownership check applies.
Returns paginated turn records for a session. Use before_id for cursor-based pagination. Ownership check applies.

parameters.description: Return records before this turn ID
parameters.name: before_id

get.description: Returns a list of all registered worker types and whether their binaries are installed in the host's PATH.

description.description: Description is operator-facing text, bounded and free of user content.

requires_version.description: RequiresVersion is the fencing token the action must carry.

target.description: Target names what the action applies to: "execution" or an effect ID.

bot_token.description: Credentials — only used during creation; never returned in GET responses.
Credentials — only used during creation; never returned in GET responses.

effect_evidence.description:
EffectEvidence is "not_recorded_for_this_run" when the run never planned
an external delivery, which is most runs.

notes.description: Notes are stable codes (see the note* constants), not prose.

plan_evidence.description:
PlanEvidence is explicit about absence: the launch plan is recorded per
session for the CURRENT run only, so a historical execution usually has
none. Substituting the session's present plan would rewrite history.

from_launch.description:
FromLaunch reports whether Plan is what this session's current run was
ACTUALLY launched under. False means it was re-resolved against the live
config — a different question, and one that must not be read as history.

plan_applied.description:
PlanApplied reports whether the recorded run was started from its plan
(authoritative rollout) or only shadow-compared against it. A plan that
merely AGREED with the legacy parameters is not an applied plan.

expected_status.description:
ExpectedStatus is the status the operator saw. The write is refused
unless the effect is still in exactly that state.

warning.description: workspace 同名遮蔽全局时非空

permission_ceiling.description:
PermissionCeiling is the first effective permission tier the Worker
reported after a successful start/resume — declared by the Worker, not
independently enforced (empty when never reported).

state.description: State is one of the Observed* constants.

worker_type.description: WorkerType is the worker type the session actually runs (observed fact).
